POC_DISCLAIMER.TITLE: Proof-of-Concept
POC_DISCLAIMER.MESSAGE:
This voice chat prototype purpose is just to showcase the concept and it does not represent the final quality of a solution or product. Delays, bugs and other issues may occur.
Key features: Autonomous web navigation, Text highlighting and Form filling.

GREETING.1: Hello! Welcome to the voice chat. How can I help you today?
GREETING.2: Hi there! I'm here to assist you with anything you need.
GREETING.3: Greetings! How may I assist you today?
GREETING.4: Welcome! Let me know what you need and I'll do my best to help.
GREETING.5: Voice assistant at your service! Ready to help!
GREETING.DEFAULT: Hello! What would you like today?

RESUME_GREETING.1: Hey, I'm back! Let's pick up where we left off.
RESUME_GREETING.3: Still here! What were we looking at?

HINTS_DEFAULT: I need a gift for my partner, can you help?
Which one is best for sensitive skin?
Can I return this if it doesn't fit?
CHAT_INPUT_PLACEHOLDER: Ask about products, shipping, or your order.
CHAT_EMPTY_HINT: Send a message to start the conversation.

UNIFIED_PROMPTS.DISCOVERY: Help me find the right product.
UNIFIED_PROMPTS.COMPARISON: Compare the best options for me.
UNIFIED_PROMPTS.GUIDANCE: Will this fit or work for my needs?
UNIFIED_PROMPTS.FAQ: Can you answer a shopping question?
